# PyTorch

> PyTorch is an open-source deep learning framework providing tools for research and production AI applications with GPU optimization and distributed training capabilities.

The PyTorch Foundation hosts the core framework alongside complementary projects like vLLM and DeepSpeed. The site offers comprehensive documentation, tutorials, and community resources for developers at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Deep Learning
- Neural Networks
- GPU Optimization
- Distributed Training
- Machine Learning
- Open Source
- PyTorch Framework
- Model Training
- Production Deployment
- Getting Started
- Code Examples
- vLLM
- DeepSpeed
- Python
- LibTorch

## Core Framework

- [PyTorch](https://pytorch.org): PyTorch Foundation homepage for open source deep learning framework.
- [PyTorch Project](https://pytorch.org/projects/pytorch): PyTorch framework project page with research and production capabilities.
- [Projects Directory](https://pytorch.org/projects): Directory of Foundation-hosted projects including vLLM and DeepSpeed.
- [vLLM](https://pytorch.org/projects/vllm): vLLM LLM inference serving engine for GPU-optimized production.
- [DeepSpeed](https://pytorch.org/projects/deepspeed): DeepSpeed distributed training and inference optimization library.

## Getting Started & Learning

- [Get Started](https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally): Local installation guide for PyTorch with Python, CUDA, and ROCm.
- [Welcome to PyTorch Tutorials](https://pytorch.org/tutorials): Tutorial index covering PyTorch basics, neural networks, and deep learning.
- [Learn the Basics](https://pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/basics/intro.html): Beginner guide to PyTorch tensors, datasets, models, and training.
- [Introduction to PyTorch - YouTube Series](https://pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/introyt.html): Video tutorial series introducing PyTorch basics via YouTube.
- [Recipes](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/recipes_index.html): PyTorch code recipes for training, profiling, and model optimization.

## Community & Support

- [Community Hub](https://pytorch.org/community-hub): PyTorch Foundation community hub with forums, events, and governance.
- [Developer Resources](https://pytorch.org/resources): Developer resources including docs, forums, GitHub, and contribution guides.
- [PyTorch Ambassadors](https://pytorch.org/programs/ambassadors): Ambassador program for community leaders and advocates.
- [Webinars](https://pytorch.org/webinars): Expert webinars and on-demand videos on PyTorch releases and techniques.
- [Meeting Calendar](https://pytorch.org/meeting-calendar): TAC meetings and working group calendar for PyTorch community.

## Ecosystem & Governance

- [Join the PyTorch Ecosystem](https://pytorch.org/join-ecosystem): Application process to join PyTorch Ecosystem through Foundation.
